moments.title: Strictly's Back!
moments.blurb: The new series of Strictly Come Dancing kicks off with its pre-recorded launch show on Saturday, September 19, revealing this year's celebrity pairings and new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Launch Hype
angles.copy: Glitterball season officially begins! Strictly Come Dancing is back on Saturday for its much-anticipated launch show. Who are you backing to win the coveted trophy?

angles.name: New Hosts Take Over
angles.copy: New era for Strictly! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe & Johannes Radebe take the reins as hosts this Saturday. Big shoes to fill, but we're ready for the sparkle! ✨

angles.name: Celebrity Reveal
angles.copy: The pairings are almost here! Which celebrity are you most excited to see hit the dancefloor when Strictly returns this weekend?

moments.title: Bake Off Returns with New Judge
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off returns for its 17th series on Tuesday, September 22, with Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a new judge, alongside returning hosts Alison Hammond and Noel Fielding.

angles.name: New Judge Excitement
angles.copy: Ready, set, BAKE! The Great British Bake Off is back next Tuesday, and there's a new face in the tent: Nigella Lawson joins Paul Hollywood. What do we think, bakers?

angles.name: Autumn Staple
angles.copy: Autumn officially begins with the return of Bake Off! Get your spatulas ready, the new series starts Tuesday on Channel 4. Who's excited for the new batch of bakers?

angles.name: Soggy Bottoms Incoming
angles.copy: It's almost time for Hollywood Handshakes and inevitable soggy bottoms! The Great British Bake Off returns Tuesday. Pass the pastries!

moments.title: Europa League Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The UEFA Europa League group stage begins today, Thursday, September 17, with UK teams Crystal Palace, Bournemouth, Celtic, and Sunderland all in action for Matchday 1.

angles.name: Live Football Tonight
angles.copy: Europa League Matchday 1 is HERE! Crystal Palace, Bournemouth, Celtic, and Sunderland are all playing tonight. Who are you cheering on?

angles.name: Palace in Europe
angles.copy: Crystal Palace are in European action tonight, facing Lech Poznań at Selhurst Park in their first Europa League group game! Big night for the Eagles!

angles.name: Bournemouth's Euro Debut
angles.copy: AFC Bournemouth make their Europa League debut today against Real Sociedad! Good luck to the Cherries!

moments.title: England vs Spain at Wembley
moments.blurb: England's men's national team takes on Spain in a highly anticipated match at Wembley Stadium on Saturday, September 26.

angles.name: Big International Fixture
angles.copy: Mark your calendars! England face Spain at Wembley next Saturday. Always a huge game, who's got their tickets?

angles.name: Three Lions Action
angles.copy: The Three Lions are back at Wembley next Saturday for a clash with Spain. Get ready for some international football action!

angles.name: England Match Hype
angles.copy: England vs Spain: a fixture guaranteed to bring the drama! Next Saturday, live from Wembley. Predict the score!

moments.title: College Football at Wembley
moments.blurb: Wembley Stadium hosts American college football this Saturday, September 19, as the Arizona State Sun Devils take on the Kansas Jayhawks in the Union Jack Classic.

angles.name: American Football in London
angles.copy: Get ready for some gridiron action! College football comes to Wembley this Saturday with the Union Jack Classic. Who's heading down?

angles.name: Wembley Hosts US Sport
angles.copy: It's not just soccer at Wembley! This Saturday, Arizona State faces Kansas in the Union Jack Classic. A taste of American college football in London!

moments.title: Sienna Spiro Tops UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Sienna Spiro has secured her first UK number-one single with 'Great Expectation' on the Official Singles Chart for the week ending September 17, 2026, making her the youngest British female to top the charts in 12 years.

angles.name: New Number One
angles.copy: Huge congrats to Sienna Spiro! 'Great Expectation' is the UK's new Official Singles Chart Number 1. Have you heard it yet?

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Sienna Spiro is officially number one with 'Great Expectation'! What a track to kick off the weekend. Tune in to hear it!

angles.name: Youngest British Female No.1
angles.copy: History made! Sienna Spiro is the youngest British female in 12 years to hit UK Number 1 with 'Great Expectation'. Incredible achievement!

moments.title: Dolly Parton's Posthumous Chart Impact
moments.blurb: Following her passing earlier in August at age 80, Dolly Parton's classic hits '9 to 5' and 'Jolene' have seen a significant chart resurgence, landing at numbers 9 and 17 respectively on the latest Official Singles Chart.

angles.name: Dolly's Legacy
angles.copy: Dolly Parton's music lives on! Her timeless classics '9 to 5' and 'Jolene' are back in the UK charts following her recent passing. A true icon.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: The Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, is still making waves! '9 to 5' and 'Jolene' are soaring up the charts. What's your favourite Dolly track?

moments.title: Autumn Equinox Approaches
moments.blurb: The Autumn Equinox, marking the official start of astronomical autumn in the Northern Hemisphere, occurs next Wednesday, September 23, at 01:05 BST.

angles.name: Hello Autumn
angles.copy: Autumn is officially on its way! Next Wednesday marks the Autumn Equinox, bringing longer nights and crisper days. What's your favourite thing about autumn?

angles.name: Seasonal Shift
angles.copy: The days are getting shorter! The Autumn Equinox arrives next Wednesday, signalling the start of astronomical autumn. Time for cosy nights in!

moments.title: Full Moon on Saturday
moments.blurb: Look up to the skies next Saturday, September 26, for the September Full Moon.

angles.name: Moon Gazing
angles.copy: The skies will be lit up next Saturday with the September Full Moon! Perfect for some late-night stargazing. Will you be watching?

angles.name: Celestial Event
angles.copy: Get ready for a celestial treat! The Full Moon graces our skies next Saturday. A beautiful way to end the week.

moments.title: Happy 58th Anastacia!
moments.blurb: American singer-songwriter Anastacia, known for hits like 'I'm Outta Love' and her powerful 'sprock' sound, celebrates her 58th birthday today.

angles.name: Birthday Shout-out
angles.copy: Sending huge birthday wishes to the incredible Anastacia, who turns 58 today! What's your favourite track from the 'I'm Outta Love' singer?

angles.name: Sprock Sound
angles.copy: Happy 58th Birthday to Anastacia, the voice behind that iconic 'sprock' sound! Still sounds amazing today. Crank up her hits!

moments.title: Doug E. Fresh Turns 60
moments.blurb: Pioneering American rapper, beatboxer, and producer Doug E. Fresh, known as 'The Human Beat Box,' celebrates his 60th birthday today.

angles.name: Hip Hop Legend
angles.copy: Happy 60th Birthday to the legendary Doug E. Fresh! The Human Beat Box himself, still influencing music today. What's your favourite beatbox track?

angles.name: Birthday to a Pioneer
angles.copy: Celebrating the 60th birthday of hip-hop pioneer Doug E. Fresh today! His contributions to rap and beatboxing are immense.

moments.title: Liam Gallagher is 54

angles.name: Rock Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher on Monday! What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

angles.name: Legendary Frontman
angles.copy: The legendary Liam Gallagher turns 54 on Monday! Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. Let's hear it for the main man!

moments.title: Joan Jett Turns 68
moments.blurb: Rock icon Joan Jett, known for 'I Love Rock 'n' Roll' and her work with The Runaways and The Blackhearts, celebrates her 68th birthday on Tuesday, September 22.

angles.name: Queen of Rock
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the Queen of Rock 'n' Roll, Joan Jett, on Tuesday! What's your go-to Joan Jett anthem?

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Legend
angles.copy: It's Joan Jett's 68th birthday on Tuesday! Still loving rock 'n' roll and looking good doing it. Celebrate with her greatest hits!

moments.title: The Boss Turns 77
moments.blurb: American rock legend Bruce Springsteen, known as 'The Boss,' will celebrate his 77th birthday next Wednesday, September 23.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Boss
angles.copy: Next Wednesday, we're celebrating the 77th birthday of The Boss, Bruce Springsteen! What's your all-time favourite Springsteen track?

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Bruce Springsteen turns 77 next Wednesday! Still rocking stadiums and hearts. Let's send him some birthday love!

moments.title: Avril Lavigne is 42
moments.blurb: Canadian pop-punk icon Avril Lavigne, known for hits like 'Complicated' and 'Sk8er Boi,' celebrates her 42nd birthday next Sunday, September 27.

angles.name: Pop Punk Princess
angles.copy: Happy 42nd Birthday to the Pop Punk Princess, Avril Lavigne, next Sunday! What's your favourite throwback Avril track?

angles.name: Still Complicated
angles.copy: Avril Lavigne turns 42 next Sunday! From 'Complicated' to her latest bangers, she's still a punk rock icon. What's your top Avril song?

moments.title: Lil Wayne Turns 44
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning American rapper Lil Wayne, one of hip-hop's most influential artists, celebrates his 44th birthday next Sunday, September 27.

angles.name: Hip Hop Royalty
angles.copy: Wishing a huge 44th Birthday to hip-hop royalty, Lil Wayne, next Sunday! What's your favourite Weezy verse?

angles.name: Tunechi Turns 44
angles.copy: Next Sunday, Lil Wayne, aka Tunechi, celebrates his 44th birthday! Drop your favourite Lil Wayne track to celebrate!
